metadata.title: Isolated singularities of solutions to the Yamabe equation in higher dimensions I
metadata.abstract: We complete, in the Riemannian setting, the classification of isolated singularities of positive solutions to the Yamabe equation for \(3\le n\le 29\), initiated in the flat case by Caffarelli, Gidas, and Spruck in 1989. Precisely, every isolated singularity is either removable or asymptotic to a Fowler solution. The sharpness of this range is established by counterexamples for \(n\ge30\) in our subsequent paper.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: Yamabe 方程孤立奇点分类
analysis.workSummary: 在 Riemannian 背景完成 3≤n≤29 维 Yamabe 方程正解的孤立奇点分类：奇点可去，或解渐近于 Fowler 解。
analysis.breakthrough: 把平坦背景的经典分类推广至所述维数范围的 Riemannian 情形。
analysis.limitations: 维数上限不可任意扩展；n≥30 的反例由后续论文给出，本篇不应被表述为所有维数的分类。
analysis.priorityReason: 把平坦背景的经典分类推广至所述维数范围的 Riemannian 情形。
